set.title: React Machine Coding Interview Questions
set.subtitle: Real coding-round questions and UI scenarios. Open any question, build the component in the live editor, and run it instantly.

questions.title: Star Rating Widget
questions.description: Build a reusable star rating with a hover preview and a selected value.

questions.title: Accordion / FAQ
questions.description: Expand one panel at a time from a list of items.

questions.title: Tabs Component
questions.description: Switch content panels via a tab bar with an active indicator.

questions.title: Stopwatch
questions.description: Start/stop/reset a timer using an interval id stored in a ref.

questions.title: Pagination
questions.description: Page through a list with Prev/Next and numbered page buttons.

questions.title: Autocomplete / Typeahead
questions.description: Filter a suggestion list as the user types and pick a value.

questions.title: Traffic Light
questions.description: Cycle through states on a timer with per-state durations.

questions.title: Tic-Tac-Toe
questions.description: A 3×3 game with alternating turns and win/draw detection.

questions.title: Implement Debouncing
questions.description: Delay reacting to a fast-changing value until the user pauses typing.

questions.title: Implement a Search Box
questions.description: Filter a list live as the user types, with an empty-state message.

questions.title: Implement a Todo List
questions.description: Add, complete and delete items while updating an array immutably.

questions.title: Nested Comments Thread
questions.description: Render a recursive comment tree and update deeply nested state immutably.

questions.title: CRUD Operations in a Table
questions.description: Create, read, update and delete rows of a table backed by a single form.

questions.title: Stop Duplicate API Calls
questions.description: Guard against firing multiple concurrent requests when a trigger is spammed.

questions.title: Country & State Dependent Dropdowns
questions.description: Load the second dropdown's options based on the first dropdown's selection.

questions.title: Dark / Light Theme Toggle
questions.description: Switch the whole UI between light and dark by driving a class from state.

questions.title: Infinite Scroll
questions.description: Load the next batch of items automatically as the user scrolls to the bottom.

questions.title: Multi-Step Progress Bar with Validation
questions.description: A configurable step wizard where Next is blocked until the current step is valid.

questions.title: C-Shaped Boxes — Click & Auto-Reset
questions.description: Track click order, then unwind it on a timer — a classic sequencing puzzle.

questions.title: Transfer List (Merge APIs + Move Between Boxes)
questions.description: Merge two API responses, de-duplicate, and move selected items between two lists.

questions.title: Typewriter Effect
questions.description: Reveal text one character at a time on demand, with a blinking caret.

questions.title: OTP Input
questions.description: A segmented OTP field with auto-advance, backspace navigation and paste support.

questions.title: Multi-Select Checkboxes with Select All
questions.description: Sync a Select-All checkbox with individual checkboxes, both ways.

questions.title: Implement useFetch for API Calls
questions.description: Extract data fetching (loading / error / data) into a reusable custom hook.

questions.title: Counter Component using a Custom Hook
questions.description: Move counter logic into a reusable hook and use it across multiple components.

questions.title: Drag & Drop Reorderable List

questions.description: Render N concentric circles from a number input using a recursive component.

questions.title: Cancel API Calls with AbortController
questions.description: Cancel an in-flight request with AbortController — on demand, on re-fetch, and on unmount.

questions.title: Tree Structure (Expand / Collapse)
questions.description: Render a nested tree where every node can expand to reveal its children.

questions.title: Quiz Component
questions.description: A multi-question quiz with navigation, answer tracking and a final score.

questions.title: Generate a Table of Numbers
questions.description: Render an R×C table filled with sequential numbers from two inputs.

questions.title: Like Button
questions.description: Toggle a liked state and reflect it in the button's appearance and count.

questions.title: Users Table with Sorting
questions.description: Sort a data table by clicking column headers, toggling ascending/descending.

questions.description: A VS-Code-style file tree where folders expand/collapse and files are leaves.

questions.title: Timer with Progress Bar
questions.description: A countdown timer whose progress bar fills as time elapses, with start/pause/reset.

questions.title: Password Strength Check
questions.description: Score a password against rules and show a live strength meter + checklist.

questions.title: Form with Validation
questions.description: A controlled form that validates on submit and shows inline error messages.

questions.title: Multi-Select Dropdown
questions.description: A dropdown that supports search, select all, clear all and a selected count.

questions.title: Shopping Cart
questions.description: Add/remove items, adjust quantity, apply a coupon, compute totals and persist the cart.

questions.title: Session Timeout System
questions.description: Detect inactivity, warn with a countdown, allow extending, and auto-logout.

questions.title: Optimistic UI — Like Button
questions.description: Update the UI immediately, then roll back if the API call fails.

questions.title: Character Counter
questions.description: A text field limited to a max length with a live character count.

questions.title: Copy to Clipboard
questions.description: Copy a value with the Clipboard API and give temporary button feedback.

questions.title: File Upload with Image Preview
questions.description: Preview a selected image before uploading it.

questions.title: Scroll-to-Top Button
questions.description: Show a floating button after scrolling down, that smoothly returns to the top.

questions.title: User Profile Edit
questions.description: Load a user, edit their details in a form, then save or cancel the changes.

questions.title: Half-Star Rating
questions.description: A star rating that supports half values based on which half of a star you hover/click.

questions.title: Nested Accordion (Tree)
questions.description: Render a recursive accordion from a tree; each node expands/collapses its children independently.

questions.title: Nested Checkbox Tree
questions.description: Recursive checkbox tree where checking a parent toggles all descendants and parents reflect a checked / unchecked / indeterminate state.

questions.title: Optimistic UI — Like Button
questions.description: Update the UI instantly on click, then reconcile with a simulated API — rolling back on failure.

questions.title: Show More / Show Less Text
questions.description: Truncate long text to a character limit with a toggle to expand and collapse it.

questions.title: Reusable Modal Dialog
questions.description: Build a reusable modal that opens, closes on the X, closes on outside click, and closes on submit.

questions.title: Temperature Converter
questions.description: Convert temperatures between Celsius and Fahrenheit with two synced inputs.

questions.title: Expense Tracker
questions.description: Add expenses through a validated form, list them, delete any, and keep a live total.

questions.title: Authentication Context
questions.description: Manage global auth state with Context + useReducer and render UI based on it.

questions.title: Password Visibility Toggle
questions.description: Toggle a password field between hidden and visible with a show/hide button.

questions.title: Counter with Step
questions.description: A counter that increments/decrements by a user-defined step, with reset.

questions.title: Scroll-to-Section Tabs
questions.description: Clicking a tab smoothly scrolls to its section and marks the tab active.

questions.title: Sidebar
questions.description: A right-side sidebar that slides in/out from a fixed, always-visible toggle button.

questions.title: Price Range Slider
questions.description: A dual-handle price range slider synced with number inputs, with a filled track and constraints.

questions.title: Product Filter (Fetch + Price + Rating)
questions.description: Fetch products from an API and filter them by price range and minimum rating together.
